notes.title: Seafrog Patch Notes v1.0.1.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Multi-item holding

notes.title: Seafrog Patch 1.0.0.13
notes.content:
Hello again! Today we're patching some game breaking issues and adding some new How-To's:

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]New How-To entries for Sea Goblin, Teleporters and Med Bot
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for softlock when pressing specific button combination at the Furnace
[*]Fix for being able to interact with the Seaplane too early
[*]Fixes for visibility of Toxic Barrels
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed compression for in-game videos. Install size of game reduced by about 100MB
[/list]

If you find any bugs or have feedback on the game please join the [url=https://discord.gg/FwmsTEgnZB]DISCORD[/url] and let us know!

notes.title: Seafrog 1.0.0.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey all! We've got a small bug fix and balance patch for you:

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*]Several level updates that make some areas less punishing overall.
[*]Slightly reduced difficulty of Chacken boss and end game.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for limited resolution options on Steam Deck
[*]Fix for not being able to change resolution with a controller.
[*]Fixes for abnormal performance during the tutorial.
[*]Fixed issue with Power Cells that would cause an error breaking hit boxes for agent interactivity
[*]Fix for door unlock audio playing when loading save data
[*]Some fixes for crab not staying in Seafrog's arms.
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*]New Game Icon
[/list]

If you find any bugs or have feedback on the game please join the [url=https://discord.gg/FwmsTEgnZB]DISCORD[/url] and let us know!

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.4.40.5
notes.content:
Seafrog Demo Patch Notes v0.4.40.5

[list]
[*]Complete overhaul of the jumping system (Seafrog no longer pre-loads his jump but instead jumps on press. The longer a jump is held the higher he goes.)
[*]New rooms and challenges added!
[*]New Mod Chips added (can you find all 4?)
[*]Improved tutorialization
[*]And of course... lots of bug fixes
[/list]
